1.eng: Before I was baptized into the Church, the missionaries taught me about tithes and offerings. After my baptism, through summer jobs, I had the opportunity to pay full tithes and fast offerings. However, at that time, I did not fully understand the meaning of the promises and blessings associated with obedience to this law.

1.spa: Antes de ser bautizado en la Iglesia, los misioneros me enseñaron acerca de los diezmos y las ofrendas. Después de mi bautismo, gracias a los trabajos de verano, tuve la oportunidad de pagar diezmos íntegros y ofrendas de ayuno. Sin embargo, en ese momento, no entendía plenamente el significado de las promesas y de las bendiciones relacionadas con la obediencia a esta ley.

2.eng: It was not until my missionary service that I had the opportunity to teach this commandment and bear testimony of it. While serving in the Chile Osorno Mission, in the city of Puerto Montt, Elder Ruben Alvarez and I began teaching a woman who was about 70 years old and lived with her son, who was a member of the Church. She could not read and had difficulty retaining what we taught her, so we needed to repeat each lesson twice.

I have met families who once worried about their next meal but who now enjoy greater stability.
